caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel divided vertically into seven equal sections with alternating background colors of yellow, blue-grey, and white. Each section contains symmetrical, stylized black floral and vine motifs, with patterns of curved leaves, flowers, and seed-like shapes. The top and bottom edges of the panel are bordered with a horizontal band featuring a repeating floral and scroll design in green and yellow tones, with small yellow flower shapes spaced evenly along the band. The overall color palette is primarily yellow, blue-grey, green, and black, with the background of the drawing remaining off-white. The drawing is organized symmetrically, with each vertical panel containing repeated and mirrored motifs, and decorative borders along the top and bottom. A small number "23" appears at the lower left corner outside the main panel.
title: Plate 22: Wall Decoration: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
